priorities.topic: Japan's 154-year train station network: infrastructure longevity lessons for US transit
priorities.angle: Data journalism deep-dive: what 9,300 stations built over 154 years reveals about infrastructure investment timelines, density vs ridership tradeoffs, and policy lessons for chronically under-funded US transit systems. HN viral hook (animated station map) gives strong entry point.
priorities.rationale: Trending #5 on Hacker News today — animated visualization of all 9,300 Japanese stations 1872-2026 is a viral hook that sits squarely in our transit niche. No comparable US coverage drawing policy lessons. Long-form article format allows depth that short-form competitors skip. Strong data journalism angle with high share potential.

priorities.topic: The transit infrastructure lifecycle: from groundbreaking to decommissioning
priorities.angle: Visual explainer showing the full asset lifecycle — planning, construction, operation, maintenance, end-of-life, and surplus/reuse — triggered by the Swiss Federal Railways publicly selling trains, bridges, and track. Connects sustainability policy to transit infrastructure economics.
priorities.rationale: Swiss Railway surplus sale trending on HN today (#4). No transit-niche publication has covered this angle. Strong visual format: lifecycle flowchart with cost/timeline data at each phase. High editorial value and pairs well with Rank 1 Japan article.

priorities.topic: Electric axial flux motors and the coming revolution in urban transit vehicles
priorities.angle: Mercedes-Benz begins large-scale production of compact axial flux electric motors — explain why this miniaturization breakthrough matters specifically for electric buses and light rail, which cities' fleets are positioned to retrofit first, and what it means for transit electrification timelines.
priorities.rationale: Mercedes EV motor news trending (#3 on HN). Electric transit vehicles are underserved in our library vs. auto-centric EV coverage. Video/short-form format ideal for tech explainers with a transit hook. Strong YouTube and social share potential targeting transit/EV crossover audience.

priorities.topic: AI vendor data-sharing mandates and the public transit agency dilemma
priorities.angle: AWS Bedrock's new requirement to share customer data with Anthropic for future model training raises urgent questions for transit agencies using AI SaaS tools. Research brief covers: what data transit agencies are feeding AI vendors, emerging federal guidance, and recommended data governance frameworks for public-sector mobility programs.
priorities.rationale: AWS/Anthropic data policy trending on HN (#8). Intersects our core AI + infrastructure policy niche in an underreported direction. No competitor has bridged AI vendor governance to transit/public-sector implications. Timely given growing transit agency AI adoption.
